tg.text: {Имя}, you are in! The 3-day "From messy data to a clean dashboard" mini-course starts with a live lesson at {webinar.time} MSK. I will remind you before each lesson. Meanwhile, take a look around the classroom 👇
Let us get acquainted I am Alex, I have been automating spreadsheets for 9 years. Over the next three days you will build one working dashboard from scratch.
One question before we start What is the messiest table you work with? Reply in one message – I will use the best examples in the lessons.
Homework and recordings live in the classroom channel 👉 {channel.link}
The plan for three days Day 1 – clean the data. Day 2 – build the model. Day 3 – draw the dashboard.
Prepare for the lesson Download the practice workbook and open it in your spreadsheet app.
{Имя}, day 1 starts in one hour Open a blank workbook – we will import a messy export and clean it live.
We are live! Day 1: cleaning the data 👇
Missed day 1? The recording is ready – it takes 40 minutes and you will be back on track.
Want the full course? 12 lessons, templates for every case and a mentor who checks your homework.
Good morning, {Имя}! Today we turn the clean table into a model that updates itself.
Day 2 starts in one hour Bring yesterday's workbook.
We are live! Day 2: building the model 👇
Last day, {Имя}! Today the model becomes a dashboard people actually read.
The final lesson starts in one hour
Missed the final lesson? The recording is waiting for you.
The doors close tonight Last chance to join the full course at the launch price.
